Step: 1566 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 09-29 back 121 days:  
September has 30 days, so back 29 days → 09-01.  
Remaining: 121 - 29 = 92 days earlier.  
August (31 days) → 08-01 after 31 days back → 08-01. Remaining: 92 - 31 = 61 days.  
July (31 days) → 07-01 after 31 days back → 07-01. Remaining: 61 - 31 = 30 days.  
June (30 days) → back 30 days from 07-01 → 06-01.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1566-06-01
